$comment: Canonical UI screen registry — the AI's map of the app's screens. Each screen maps to its route, the module it belongs to (module_key), a one-line purpose, and the AI action_keys reachable from it. Keep this in sync when adding a route (see doc/AI_READINESS.md). Ingested into the AI global corpus by src/services/ai/knowledge/codebase.js; also usable by the frontend for nav/breadcrumbs.
$comment_actions: `actions[]` is now COMPLETE for every <module>.ai.js manifest action, not just a sample. It is read in both directions: screen->actions grounds the assistant ('where do I raise an invoice?'), and the INVERSION action->route is how src/services/ai/answer-sources.js turns the reads the orchestrator executed into the citations under an answer. An action missing here is an answer that cannot say where it read from, so tests/unit/ai-readiness.test.js asserts every manifest read is declared on exactly one screen. Where a module owns several screens the split is by entity, not by module_key (MOD-64's signatures live on /vault/signatures, its documents on /vault/documents).

screens.title: Reconciliation
screens.purpose: Reconcile a treasury account against its external truth — a bank or mobile-money statement (CSV/Excel/PDF/camt.053/MT940, a scanned PDF read by OCR), or a physical count for petty cash. Upload, confirm the column mapping once per institution, sweep the ledger for candidate matches, then issue the etat de rapprochement. The matcher only ever proposes: confirming a match, approving a reconciliation and attesting a count are human acts and are not exposed to the assistant.

screens.title: Lead 360
screens.purpose: Full dossier for a single lead — Overview, Meetings (with the F1 discovery sections and their capture state), Quote requests, Proposals, Opportunities, Enquiries triaged in, and the audit history. The join F6 made necessary: the funnel, the intake lifecycle and the pipeline stage live on three different rows, so this is the one place that shows a company's whole story. Money is gated on finance visibility. Its reads are declared on the registers above; this screen adds no manifest action of its own.

screens.title: Contact enquiries
screens.purpose: Contact-form enquiry desk (MOD-25). 5 KPI tiles (TOTAL / NEW / READ / RESPONDED / CLOSED) partition the result set under every filter — the legacy's four omit READ, so opened-but-unanswered messages are counted in the total and shown in no tile. Replying sends the email through the tenant's SUPPORT identity and only marks the enquiry RESPONDED if it lands; every attempt, including failures, is kept. Triage raises a lead and/or a partnership request without touching the correspondence status.

screens.title: Quote requests
screens.purpose: Logistics-scope intake register (MOD-20-intake). 5 KPI tiles (TOTAL / RECEIVED / UNDER_REVIEW / QUOTED / CONVERTED) partition the result set under every filter; conversion produces an opportunity in the pipeline.

screens.title: Intake 360
screens.purpose: Full dossier for a single quote request — Overview, the full logistics Scope, Attachments from the vault, Proposals reached through the lead, and the audit history, plus the opportunity it converted into. 'Is it converted' is read from converted_opportunity_id, never from the status value. Its reads are declared on the register above; this screen adds no manifest action of its own.
